exposure: Twin total birth weight above 90th percentile ("growth promoted twins")
Twin total birth weight between 50th and 90th percentile ("normally grown twins")
cohort: This study involved data from dichorionic-diamniotic twins born at 34 weeks of gestational age or later over a sixteen-year period (2002-2018) in Slovenia.
finding: In contrast to macrosomia in singletons, macrosomia in twins does not appear to increase the risk for adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: There was a lower rate of caesarean births in women in the "growth promoted" twin group (48.2% vs 53.9%, OR 0.80 CI 0.64 - 0.99).
birth_weight: Total twin birth weight above 90th percentile ("growth promoted twins") and between 50th and 90th percentile ("normally grown twins")
